anomalies.description: A large group of individuals engages in violent unrest on a street at night, including throwing objects, running, clashing with others, and using sticks or poles as weapons; police in riot gear are present and appear to be attempting to control the situation.
Multiple pairs of individuals are engaged in direct physical combat in the center of the intersection, including grappling and striking; one person is seen falling during the clash.
At least one individual is on the ground while others surround and appear to strike or kick them; the victim shows no ability to defend themselves during this interval.

Two individuals engage in physical combat near the rear of the police car: one person in a grey hoodie is bent over while another in dark clothing appears to strike or grapple with them. This is distinct from the broader riot activity.

A crowd surrounds a police car; individuals are seen smashing the vehicle's windows and attacking it with objects, while others observe or participate in the unrest. The scene shows sustained collective violent behavior against property and authority.

A second police car (Ford Focus) is struck by a person jumping from a red double-decker bus onto its roof, causing visible impact and deformation; this constitutes a deliberate vehicle collision event.
A person in blue jeans jumps onto the hood of a silver police car, then is pushed off by another individual; they engage in mutual physical combat involving grappling and striking.

Sustained collective violent unrest: multiple individuals assault police vehicles (jumping on hoods, breaking windows), attack officers or civilians, and use objects (e.g., trash bin) as weapons amid a chaotic street scene with multiple police cars and bystanders fleeing.
A group of at least four individuals surrounds and attacks a person near the silver police car, involving punching, shoving, and one assailant using a trash bin as a weapon.
Police officers in riot gear engage in physical confrontation with individuals on a sidewalk; one officer appears to strike or push a person while others surround and restrain.

A group of individuals, many hooded and wearing dark clothing, crowd against a brick wall and window, appearing to force entry or break into a building; police are present but not directly intervening in this segment.

A group of individuals is engaged in close physical struggle near a brick wall and doorway; multiple people are seen pushing, grabbing, and restraining one another, with visible grappling and forceful contact throughout the sequence.

A group of individuals in dark clothing are engaged in mutual physical combat against one or more people near a brick wall; visible pushing, grabbing, and striking motions occur across multiple frames.

Escalation to collective violent unrest: the fighting expands into a larger crowd confrontation involving multiple participants, with chaotic movement and apparent attempts to restrain or assault individuals; police in riot gear appear at the end (f15), indicating response to disorder.; A tense confrontation between a group of civilians (including a woman in a pink hoodie gesturing and speaking animatedly) and a line of police officers in riot gear (helmets, visors, shields). The officers are holding defensive positions while civilians press close; some individuals raise arms or appear to shout. The scene shows collective unrest with potential for escalation, but no overt physical violence is visible in the frames.; The crowd has dispersed from the immediate police line; individuals are walking across a street intersection, some wearing dark clothing and face coverings. The scene remains chaotic and suggests ongoing unrest or dispersal after a confrontation, consistent with post-riot movement. No direct combat or police engagement is visible, but the context and behavior indicate continuation of a riotous event.

A red car is engulfed in flames on a street, with thick smoke filling the air and multiple onlookers present; debris is scattered on the pavement near a damaged yellow shuttered storefront, indicating violent unrest.

Sudden intense fire erupting from the red car (visible at f15) suggests an explosion or rapid ignition event, distinct from slow-burning fire; the fire appears to intensify abruptly between f14 and f15.
A red car is engulfed in flames on a street with multiple bystanders observing; debris is scattered on the pavement, and smoke is thick—indicative of deliberate arson during unrest.
A sudden bright flash and expanding fireball erupt from a building/shed behind a blue car (visible in f6–f7), consistent with a small explosion or detonation, distinct from the sustained car fire.
